verdict.rationale: Notion positions itself as one system of record (notion-docs-6) built on pages and databases (notion-docs-1, notion-docs-26). Hands-on community reports describe teams using it as a wiki alongside project and task tracking, balancing structured PM tools with unstructured docs (notion-comm-3, notion-comm-6, notion-comm-11, notion-comm-15). missing for 10: first-party product docs on real-time co-editing, sharing permissions and page organization (the docs cited are mostly API-focused), plus detail on how docs link to project databases; community notes on slowness and limits on automation are relevant caveats.
